title: /runtime/agent agent-control ledgers require the runtime-change permission
statement: GET /runtime/agent serves the .git/agent-control task manifests (objective, branch, baseline and current SHA, next action) and the branch-audit ledger only to a key holding Permission.CHANGE_RUNTIME; a read-only key gets 403 without any ledger content, and the Runtime panel shows that 403 as a missing operator key rather than as a rejected key or an empty ledger.
failure_mode: The route used the runtime read dependencies (VIEW_STATUS), which Role.READ_ONLY holds, so any read-only dashboard key could read in-flight engineering work: task objectives, branches, SHAs and the branch-audit ledger. The deciding test asserted the defect itself by fetching the ledgers with the read-only key; it now asserts 403 for that key and 200 for the operator key, so a route that drops back to VIEW_STATUS fails it.
